long_biography.plain_text:
Offshore powerboat racing became a defining pursuit for Niclas Johansson after he began competing in the early 1990s. With experience in drag-boat racing and high-performance monohulls and catamarans, he joined Norway's Zabo Racing for the 2015 Class 1 world championship. As driver, he was responsible for steering and choosing race lines.

Away from racing, Johansson applied an acquisition-led approach to industrial services. Borrkompaniet began with concrete drilling before he added demolition and remediation businesses, creating a group able to manage projects from dismantling through material recovery. After selling the group, he retained interests in property and private companies and later took an operating role in Grisslehamn's year-round marina and hospitality complex.
